items.title: Can AST SpaceMobile stock rebound after sharp sell-off?
items.excerpt: AST SpaceMobile shares came under heavy selling pressure on October 13, falling about 8.5% by the close, according to MarketBeat. Earlier in the session, the decline reached 9.07%, taking shares to $46.80. The sell-off reflected mounting concerns over the satellite communications company's technical outlook and competitive position. (Sources KuCoin | MarketBeat) AST SpaceMobile Stock Slides
